title: Claude Code bootstrap & environment friction repair (gap + CG-01/02/04/05/06/08/09/10)
objective: Repair the confirmed Claude Code bootstrap/environment defects in Quantum-L9/Cursor-Governance at their existing owners, in one PR with six commits: (U1) delegate the governance uv proof to ensure_uv_environment.sh check so Cursor-Governance is no longer permanently UNPROVEN; (U2) never mutate git-tracked project skill entries or manifests; (U3) declare hook locality once in the precommit hook contract and enforce it; (U4) gate Cursor-only wiring checks on is_cursor_host_surface; (U5) consumer-pinned ruff via uv tool run, real .venv for pip repos, full requirements fingerprint, gitleaks absolute-path resolution with one pin; (U6) prove the org PR template before push and record GitHub capabilities per transport in the bootstrap receipt. GAR 0.8.2 manifest load_order (14 artifacts) resolved and parsed; architecture recorded as already settled: repair existing owners, no new layers (full Reasoning-Foursome run not executed).
success_criteria: session_deps_cloud.sh reports Cursor-Governance proven and a second run reports cached and proven
a consumer repo with tracked relative .claude/skills links and tracked manifest has identical git status --porcelain before and after two reconcile runs, with a tracked-owned conflict reported
cursor-skill-projection and no-hardcoded-paths are skipped in a consumer workspace; in governance each hook runs at most once; a hook without locality fails validate_precommit_hook_contract.py
check_governance_wiring.sh --machine under L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE=claude-code emits no ~/.cursor FAIL lines; unset surface keeps the plugin-sibling failure

a consumer pinning ruff==0.16.0 never runs governance ruff 0.16.1; unavailable pinned ruff fails before writer hooks; requirements-dev.txt changes the deps fingerprint; pip-only repo gets .venv and stamp; gitleaks in ~/.local/bin found with bare PATH
open_pr_after_gate.sh fails before git push when the org template is unreadable; bootstrap receipt carries github_capabilities with four per-transport verdicts

out: Odoo publish exception (CG-03) and Enterprise Docker evidence (EXT-02)
